# TR-002: the guest side menu no longer calls signed-in endpoints

_2026-11-04. Triage [TR-002](../triage.md). Review [08 Platform](../system-review/08-platform.md)._

## Problem

Opening the side menu as a guest sent six requests that need a session, and the backend answered each with 401:
`GET /api/users/me/stats`, `/auth/me`, `/notifications/unread-count`, `/saves`, `/housing/my-listings`,
`/restaurants/my-restaurants`. Nothing showed on screen, but every guest menu open cost six failed requests and six
warnings in the backend log. Found in the [smoke run](../device-runs/2026-11-04-00-smoke.md), S-14.

## Cause

`frontend/apps/mobile/components/HamburgerMenu.tsx:77-80` called `useSidebarStore.getState().refreshIfStale(...)`
whenever the menu became visible, signed in or not. `refreshIfStale` runs `fetchSidebarData`
(`src/store/sidebar.store.ts:42-53`), which requests all six endpoints without checking for a session. Every other
caller of `fetchSidebarData` already runs only with a session: login and signup after success, the root layout when
`isAuthed` turns true (`app/_layout.tsx:60-65`), profile and create-post.

## Change

`HamburgerMenu.tsx`: the menu-open effect returns early when `isAuthed` is false, and lists `isAuthed` in its
dependencies. The guest menu shows only static items (sign-in, help, privacy, theme), so it needs none of that
data. The store itself is unchanged, so the post-login calls behave as before.

## Commit

None yet (repository not committed).

## How it was checked

- `pnpm typecheck`: no new error (the existing `expo-modules-core` error in `src/services/audioPlayback.ts`
  remains, T-006).
- On the phone (OnePlus Nord CE4, Android 16, Expo Go, local backend), after restarting Metro so the change loaded:
  - signed in as `ui_tester`: the menu shows name, email, city and counts; the six sidebar requests return 304;
  - signed out, then opened the guest menu: the backend log shows **no request at all** after `POST /auth/logout`
    (before the fix: six 401s at the same step);
  - signed back in: `POST /auth/login 201` followed by the six sidebar requests, all 304.
- Not checked: iOS; a development build.

## Way back

Revert the one effect in `HamburgerMenu.tsx`.
